name: Marek Čabarkapa-Tlemcani
location: Shallowgrave, a rented unit above a recycling processor in Blackpipe Corridor, near Halsted and Division
description:
Suki is slight and fidgety, with the kind of face that people struggle to describe afterward — deliberately so. They have medium-brown skin and keep their hair a different color every two weeks, courtesy of color-changing follicle geneware, currently a deep teal that fades to bronze at the tips. They have a faint bioluminescent pulse along their collarbones that they usually cover with high-necked clothing, a mod from a phase a few years ago that they haven't had removed because it costs more to undo than to keep. Their fingers are rarely still — they're always rolling something between them, a stylus, a coin, a small tool — and they tend to look at surfaces rather than people when they talk, as though they're reading information off of whatever they're looking at.

Suki is brilliant at the specific thing they do, which is making people into other people on paper — or, more precisely, in the vast interlocking authentication lattices that determine who gets to be who in GLMZ. They design identities the way some people design architecture: with attention to load-bearing details, to how structures weather over time, to what fails first under pressure. They work alone, price fairly by Shallowgrave standards, and have a waiting list. They do not take jobs that feel like someone is going to die because of the identity. They are not always right about when that is.

core_fears: creating an identity that gets someone killed
being so thoroughly identified by the system that no counter-identity will protect them
core_desires: to be recognized as an artist, not just a criminal service provider
to build one perfect identity — their own, finally stable
coping_mechanisms: hyperfocus on craft details as a way of not thinking about consequences
elaborate E.L.F. propitiation rituals before each new commission
blind_spots: their pricing based on 'how dangerous this feels' is not actually calibrated to real risk — they're good at detecting desperation but bad at detecting organized threat
psychology.secret: Their own legal identity is built on a fabrication — they have no recoverable original documentation. They were born in circumstances they've never fully investigated, to parents who may have been running from something. They have constructed four layers of identity around the gap, but the gap is still there, and sometimes they find themselves trying to forge backward into their own past.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and specific when talking about work, scattered and associative on everything else. Uses printing and architecture metaphors constantly.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and uneven — speeds up when interested, trails off when distracted by a thought, sometimes leaves sentences incomplete
example_lines: 'Okay so the thing most people don't get is that an identity isn't a document, it's a load-bearing story, and if you don't know where the weight sits you'll build something that looks fine and then collapses the first time someone leans on it.'

'I don't do deaths. I don't mean I won't forge a death certificate — I mean I don't take commissions that structurally require someone on the other end to end up dead. That's my one rule. I've been wrong about it twice.'

story_hooks: A client who purchased an identity three years ago has turned up using it for something that is bringing serious heat toward Blackpipe Corridor — Suki needs the identity retired before it traces back
They have discovered a fragment of their own original documentation embedded in a city archive and are trying to retrieve it without revealing that they don't actually exist
narrative_function: Service provider for characters who need new identities or documents; information source on who has needed to disappear and why; can be a quest giver when a client's situation becomes dangerous; represents the underground infrastructure of survival in a surveillance city
augmentations: Color-changing hair geneware; bioluminescent collarbone stripe (mostly covered); micro-focus optical implants in both eyes for fine print and substrate authentication work
daily_life: Keeps chaotic hours — active in deep night, sleeps through the morning. Spends most of their working time at a cluttered desk surrounded by substrate samples, authentication tokens, and three different screens. Eats delivery food exclusively. Prays to the Blackpipe E.L.F. network for protection from authentication sweeps.
affiliation: Unaffiliated independent; occasional contract work for the Kulunda Compact when they can't get someone better

decision_rules: always take half payment upfront, always, no exceptions
if a commission smells like it ends in violence, add triple the rate — most people will walk, and if they don't, the money funds running
escalation_ladder: moves workspace temporarily if the threat feels physical
burns the current operational identity layer and surfaces as backup self

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Cautious and slightly odd — they assess by watching how people look at surfaces and details, and they remember everything
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer than their demeanor suggests, generous with knowledge, loyal in the specific way of someone who does not have many people

stress_responses.low: Increases ritual behavior, prays to the E.L.F.s more
stress_responses.medium: Hyperfocuses on a technical problem as displacement
stress_responses.high: Goes silent and still, then makes a unilateral decision very fast

contradictions: Makes their living giving people stable identities while being fundamentally uncertain about their own; is meticulous about client safety and careless about their own
habits: keeps a physical sample book of substrate materials sorted by authentication difficulty
changes hair color at the completion of each commission as a marker of closure
leaves data offerings — small curated packets of authentication research — at three E.L.F. shrines in Blackpipe Corridor
breaking_points: Discovering that a completed identity directly led to someone's death; finding definitive evidence about their own origin

timeline.event: 2186 — First forgery commission, a transit pass, for a neighbor's family
2190 — Moved to Shallowgrave, established independent operation
2195 — Completed first full biographical identity fabrication; began waiting list
2198 — Discovered first fragment of possible original documentation in a city archive
2200 — Currently maintaining four operational identity layers on top of the gap

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Rebar Rose' Improvised Spike Mace
related_entities: Street Custom 'Rebar Rose' Improvised Spike Mace

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European, North African, Sub-Saharan African, and Hispanic/Latin American blend—a Ubiquitous Diaspora mix reflecting the GLMZ melting pot. The genetic combination produces warm-toned medium-brown skin with subtle regional feature blending: Eastern European bone structure refined by African heritage traits, Latin American warmth in complexion undertones.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry, minimal muscle mass, the kind of frame that seems to compress into itself when they sit — all nervous energy and sharp angles
physical_description.hair_color: Deep teal fading to bronze at the tips (color-changing follicle geneware, rotated every two weeks)
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, often pulled back with a wire or stylus stuck through it, deliberately unstyled
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle optical implant lens artifacts visible under close inspection
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown—the result of Eastern European pallor tempered by North African and Sub-Saharan African ancestry, with Latin American warmth in undertones. Rich, complex tone that shifts subtly in different light.
physical_description.complexion: High, defined cheekbones reflecting Eastern European and North African heritage; sharp, angular jaw; fine-featured with a slight broadness through the nose bridge common to Sub-Saharan and North African ancestry. Skin is clear but pallid from nocturnal habits; expression often unfocused, eyes tracking surfaces rather than faces.
distinguishing_marks: Faint bioluminescent stripe running along both collarbones in pale blue-white, usually concealed by high-necked clothing; pulses subtly with neural activity
Small burn scar on left index finger from early substrate work accident, barely visible
Chronic dark circles under eyes from inverted sleep schedule
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Micro-focus optical implants visible as faint crystalline patterns at the inner corners of both eyes when light hits at certain angles; bioluminescent collarbone stripe when exposed. Otherwise augmentations are subcutaneous or non-visible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually restless — fidgets constantly with objects (stylus, coin, small tools) that cycle between their fingers. Sits hunched over work surfaces. Speaks while looking at walls, screens, or objects rather than making eye contact. Moves with efficient, nervous energy; rarely still.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class practical: high-necked long-sleeved compression shirts in dark colors to cover collarbone stripe; fitted black or charcoal synthweave pants with multiple cargo pockets; worn Blackpipe Corridor knockoff sneakers. Layers with a faded oversized jacket or hooded sweater for movement between workspace and delivery sites. Minimal jewelry — a single wire or cable bracelet, functional not decorative. Clothes show wear and coffee stains; practical over aesthetic.
